BpfHint: Advanced: extra libpcap/BPF expression, e.g. 'len > 100' or 'not port 53'
Search: Search packets: IP, port, protocol, flags or payload text
EmptyHint: Choose a network device and press Start (F5)
NoSelection: Select a packet to see its details
StatusPaused: Paused — packets are buffered and will appear when you resume
NoDevices: No capture devices found. Try running the app as administrator (Windows) or with capture rights (Linux).
NothingToExport: There are no packets to export yet.
InvalidPort: Port must be a number between 0 and 65535.
SetupSubtitle: Everything packet capture needs — fix each item with one click.
SetupAdminOk: The app is running with administrator rights.
SetupAdminHint: Usually not needed. If devices are missing or Start fails, restart with administrator rights.
SetupAdminNeeded: Capture failed or no devices were found — this usually means the app needs administrator rights.
SetupRestartRequired: The driver is installed. Restart the app to start using it.
SetupRunningInstaller: Signature verified. Follow the Npcap installer window and click Install.
SetupInstallingLibpcap: Installing libpcap with the system package manager — enter your password if asked…
SetupFailed: Automatic installation failed: {0}. Use the Website button to install it manually.
SetupRestartFailed: Could not restart the app. Please start it again manually.
SetupDriverMissingWindows: Not installed — packets cannot be captured without it. Install downloads the official installer from npcap.com, checks its digital signature and runs it.
SetupDriverMissingLinux: Not installed — packets cannot be captured without it. Install adds it with your system package manager (you may be asked for your password).
RecordHint: While capturing, also write every packet to pcapng files on disk. Good for long captures: files rotate by size and only the newest are kept.
RecordMaxFilesHint: 0 = keep all files. Otherwise the oldest files are deleted, so disk usage stays at most size × count.
StreamTruncated: The stream is large: only the first 2 MB are shown. Copy and Save include everything.
StreamEmpty: This conversation carries no payload data.
SendWaitReply: Wait for a reply after each send
SendNoReplies: No replies yet. Tick "Wait for a reply" to collect them.
ReplayModePayload: Send payloads over a normal socket (no admin rights)
ReplayModeInject: Inject the original frames onto a network device
ReplayNoPackets: Nothing to replay. Right-click packets or a conversation and choose Replay.
ReplayBadTarget: Target must be host:port, e.g. 127.0.0.1:9000 or [::1]:9000.
ReplayHowTo: Choose what to replay from the main window: right-click a packet → "Replay the shown packets…", or right-click a conversation → "Replay…".
ReplayTargetHint: Empty = each UDP packet goes to its original destination. TCP needs a target; its payloads are sent in order over one connection.
ReplayInjectHint: Frames are sent byte for byte, with their original MAC/IP headers. Needs capture rights; the device's link type must match the capture.
ProtocolsHint: Built in: DNS, MQTT, Modbus/TCP, JSON, HTTP/text. Add your own binary protocols as JSON files in the folder below.
ProtocolsReloadedWithErrors: Protocols reloaded, some files have errors (see Protocols)
